_comment: Shrink-only baseline (same model as config/write-ratchet-baseline.json, T-316) for scraper/tsconfig.scripts.json's `exclude` array. This list is the ONLY source of legitimate exclusions for scraper/scripts/**/*.ts from `npm run type-check:scripts`. Regenerate ONLY when REMOVING an entry (a script was fixed to type-check cleanly under scraper/tsconfig.scripts.json) via `node scripts/tests/scripts-typecheck-exclude-shrink.test.mjs --update`. NEVER hand-add a new entry to grandfather a newly-broken script into the exclude list — fix the script's types instead. See issue #434 (closed 2026-09-26: all 23 fixed, list emptied).
